title: Evaluation of a new echocardiographic method to improve the diagnosis of cardiac arrhythmias
summary: Patienten während einer Herzoperation mit Herzlungenmaschine werden zusäztlich mittels spezieller Echokardiographie untersucht.

interventions.name: Patients undergoing heart surgery with a heart-lung machine are additionally examined using special echocardiography.

criteria:

Cardiac surgery (open chest and with heart-lung-maschine)

none
